amount.description: What it converts from: the investor's money.

cap_price.description: A capped SAFE's cap price before its precision, cut to 10 decimals: a post-money SAFE's cap × (1 − f) ÷ C₀, a pre-money one's cap ÷ C₀.

converted.description: round(shares × price): Dr 2700 · Cr the class once effective.

covered.description: An enabled template covers every term, so its draft is ready for approval.

discount_price.description: With a discount: the round's price × (100 − discount) ÷ 100, before its precision.

left.description: What stays on 2700 until it is settled under the terms.

ownership_at_cap.description: A post-money SAFE's: amount ÷ cap, the part of the company its cap gives it, as a percentage shown under RND-DISPLAY.

price.description: The conversion price: the lower of the cap price and the discounted round price (the round's price itself with neither), cut down to its decimals.

price_decimals.description: The decimals its terms give the conversion price.

review.description: Otherwise what the accountant completes in its draft (⚠).
examples: the accountant completes it: it follows no template, a discount

shares.description: RND-SHARE: the most whole shares with round(shares × price) within the amount.
